# iosxe_voice_class_srtp_crypto (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class SRTP Crypto configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_srtp_crypto" "example" {
  tag = 200
  cryptos = [
    {
      preference   = 1
      cipher_suite = "AEAD_AES_256_GCM"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class srtp-crypto tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `cryptos` (Attributes List) Configure preferred SRTP cipher-suite (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cryptos))
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--cryptos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cryptos`

Required:

- `preference` (Number) Set the preference order for the cipher-suite (1 = Highest)
  - Range: `1`-`4`

Optional:

- `cipher_suite` (String) - Choices: `AEAD_AES_128_GCM`, `AEAD_AES_256_GCM`, `AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_32`, `AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_srtp_crypto.example "<tag>"
```
